fields.summary_ko.0: AMD surged 13.26% on November 9 following an Oppenheimer analyst upgrade (Perform→Outperform, $600 price target, ~18% upside), rising 137.48% year-to-date.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 data center revenue of $8.5 billion (+97% YoY), Q4 guidance of approximately $17 billion (+66% YoY), and 2027 growth outlook of 80% or more suggest GPU revenue will surpass server CPU.
